English: Open Stall
A hastily-erected stall or cart, offering the barest shade and space to trade wares at a nomadic crossroads.
Barter Table
A simple wooden table or blanket on the ground where locals and travelers gather to exchange goods and gossip.
Merchants Booth
A sturdy wooden booth adorned with colorful cloths and primitive shelving, allowing merchants to display a growing variety of wares.
Covered Market
A cluster of stalls and booths beneath a large canvas or thatch awning, providing protection from the elements and attracting more distant traders.
Trading Pavilion
A semi-permanent wooden and canvas structure, with multiple stalls, animal enclosures, and space for caravan storage, hosting bustling trade fairs.
Forum Stand
A raised wooden dais at the heart of the market, used for public announcements, fair arbitration, and the most lucrative trade deals.
Arcaded Market
A permanent market structure featuring stone or timber arcades, offering weatherproofed shops and a central avenue for trade caravans to gather and store goods safely.
Forum Hall
A great timber hall adjacent to the marketplace, where major merchants gather to negotiate, feast, and resolve disputes under the watchful eye of clan elders.
Merchant Guildhouse
A fortified headquarters for the most powerful merchant families, combining storerooms, council chambers, and guest quarters for foreign traders and dignitaries.
Forum Grand Exchange

A sprawling, multi-level stone complex modeled after the great markets of the Mediterranean, hosting hundreds of traders, auction houses, and caravanserai, transforming the nomad camp into a true crossroads of the world.
